_comment: A lone block of 96 Spearmen (6 files of 16) facing west, doubled to 12 files of 8 by a plain explicatio (B), which deals the half-file drill. Drill mode, no enemy. Each man follows a man he can see: the front rank keeps its ground while its file leaders open out on the guide's line, and the rear half of each file steps sideways into the interval on its right, then comes up it in column behind its half-file leader. The expect at tick 50, just after the order, reads the deal itself: file_line_routes_crossing counts the men whose straight route to his new slot crosses that of another man of his own file line. Measured 2026-11-12 with FULL dumps on seeds 0 to 4, judged with no exemptions: the expect reads 44 on main e78d81be and 0 at e78e4277 on every seed. Main also fails path_crossing on the clip's own ticks (0.417) and the overlap floor on 2-tick dumps (2.23 wu against 2.25), and its front walks back 30.8 wu (seed 0, tick 480). At e78e4277 no verdict fails, the closest two men stay 3.71 wu apart on 2-tick dumps, the front stands within 0.02 wu of where it stood, and the drill ends between ticks 480 and 540. While the drill runs the dumped slots are each man's place behind or beside the man he follows. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd; world coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).
